oc-plugin-view

See every loaded OpenCode server plugin in the sidebar, without opening a dialog.

## Install ```sh opencode plugin add oc-plugin-view ``` Restart OpenCode. List this package before any other sidebar TUI plugin to keep its Plugins section above other rows: ```jsonc { "plugins": ["oc-plugin-view", "another-plugin"] } ``` ## Use it The plugin manager hides its list behind a dialog. `oc-plugin-view` puts the loaded plugins in a sidebar section with their state, so you can see at a glance which ones the server actually mounted. It ships a no-op server entry next to the TUI export; that is what places the section in the plugin order. The section appears when at least one other package or local server plugin is installed. It excludes its own entries, so with no other plugin installed the section is hidden. Each row shows a state: - **Active** — the server loaded the plugin; a green bullet. - **Error** — the server failed to load it; a red bullet. Click a row to open OpenCode's native plugin manager at `plugins.list`. With more than two rows, click the section header to collapse or expand it. The collapsed header reads `Plugins (N active)` or `Plugins (N active, M errors)`, and the choice persists across restarts. Builtin and SDK entries are not listed; only package and local file sources are, excluding any id or path that names `oc-plugin-view`. ### Configure it No config file. Order is set by where the entry sits in the `plugins` array. To disable, remove that entry and restart. To remove the package entirely, run `opencode plugin remove oc-plugin-view` and restart. ## Requirements - OpenCode 2.2.6 V2 CLI and TUI. - `@opentui/core` and `@opentui/solid` 0.8.0 or newer; `solid-js` 1.9.0 or newer. - Node 22 or newer, or Bun 1.4 or newer. ## Status **Unverified** — as-is, use at your own risk. ## Links - [Issues](https://github.com/nathwn12/oc-collections/issues) - [Releases](https://github.com/nathwn12/oc-collections/releases) - [Package source](https://github.com/nathwn12/oc-collections/tree/main/packages/oc-plugin-view) - [MIT licence](https://github.com/nathwn12/oc-collections/blob/main/LICENSE)

# Changelog

## [Unreleased]

## [0.2.1] - 2026-11-26


- npm metadata alignment: README wording and keywords refreshed (cosmetic).
- Failed plugins now sort before active ones in the sidebar, keeping alphabetical order inside each group.
- Server entry ids now render as their plugin name: the sidebar label strips one trailing `.host` segment (`flight-deck.host` reads as `flight-deck`), while the `source.target`/`path` fallbacks and the self-exclusion are unchanged.

## [0.1.0] - 2026-11-03

- Clicking the Plugins header now collapses and expands the section again: the sidebar no longer imports `solid-js` control-flow components, so the host's own render tracks the persisted `view.open` state instead of a second Solid instance. `bun run compile` now fails if the bundle imports `solid-js` or `solid-js/store`.
- Add a no-op server entry (`oc-plugin-view.host`) and expose the package root, so listing it in `opencode.jsonc` before other sidebar TUI plugins puts the Plugins section in the intended order.
- Add the Plugins sidebar section for installed and loaded server plugins.
